title: setClient ignores the bool return of EnumerableSet.add/remove — idempotent re-adds / removal of a non-member silently succeed
description: setClient ignores the bool return of EnumerableSet.add/remove, so an idempotent re-add or a removal of a non-member silently emits success; the caller cannot distinguish a no-op from an effective change.
impact: None — set membership stays correct; the caller merely cannot distinguish a no-op from an effective change.
justification: NEW QA. Two corroborated Slither+Aderyn unused-return flags on the same setter; no security impact, event/return-fidelity only.
recommendation: Check the bool return and revert or emit a distinct event on a no-op, or document the idempotent semantics.
